name: London, England
tagline: Christmas lights, Winter Wonderland, Bath day trip
whyParents: Classic London at Christmas, an easy AA nonstop from Philly, and Bath's market by train.

costPP.flightsBasis: AA PHL-LHR nonstop Main Cabin, mid-Dec estimate. aa.com shows PHL-London Nov 11-18 2026 from $902; Kayak puts Dec as the priciest month (avg $923 to $1,428). 1-stops are not meaningfully cheaper, so nonstop wins.
costPP.lodgingBasis: 2 hotel rooms (e.g. Premier Inn County Hall/Southbank) ~$225/room/night all-in x 2 x 6 nights / 4. Cheaper than a central 2BR rental (~GBP 450/night all-in, about $890 pp). Momondo typical $168 to $262/night.

flight.routing: PHL-LHR nonstop (AA, daily; Nov/Dec 2026 fares on sale)
flight.notes: BA also flies PHL-LHR nonstop; BA Avios is a Capital One transfer partner. Arrive Heathrow T3.

stay: South Bank/Westminster: walk to sights and lights
getAround: No car. Elizabeth line from Heathrow, Tube and buses with contactless card. GWR train Paddington to Bath ~1h 30m each way.
entry: UK ETA required: GBP 20 (~$27) each via UK ETA app or GOV.UK, usually decided within 3 working days. Not Schengen; EES/ETIAS do not apply.
events: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland: Nov 19 2026 to Jan 3 2027 (closed Dec 25), timed entry free to GBP 8.25
Christmas at Kew light trail: select dates Nov 13 2026 to Jan 3 2027, from 4:20pm, adults from GBP 29.50
Regent Street lights on since Nov 5 2026; Oxford Street switch-on date not announced
Bath Christmas Market: Nov 26 to Dec 13 2026, so Sun Dec 13 is its final day
pros: AA nonstop from PHL, no language barrier
Lights, markets and theatre at peak
cons: ETA application needed for each person

name: Vienna, Austria + Prague, Czechia
tagline: Two great Christmas-market capitals, linked by train
whyParents: Old-world Europe at its most festive: palaces, cafes and markets in two cities.

costPP.flightsBasis: Open jaw: Austrian EWR-VIE nonstop out, PRG-EWR 1-stop home (no winter nonstop from Prague). Kayak Dec median JFK-VIE RT $1,017. AA 1-stop PHL-VIE/PRG-PHL ~$900 (aa.com PHL-PRG Dec 2-11 2026 from $747 basic), so nonstop is within $250.
costPP.lodgingBasis: Vienna Innere Stadt 2BR ~$320/night all-in x 3 + Prague Old Town 2BR ~$300/night all-in x 3 = $1,860 / 4. Kayak Prague Dec avg C$406/night (all types); HouseStay Vienna 2BR $223 to $295 listed.

flight.routing: EWR-VIE nonstop (Austrian, 1 daily in Dec 2026); PRG-EWR 1 stop via VIE or FRA
flight.notes: AA option: PHL-VIE out, PRG-PHL back, 1 stop each way (often via LHR on BA, Avios transfer partner). AA PHL-VIE nonstop starts May 2027, too late.

weather.precip: gray, light rain or snow ~8 days/month

stay: Vienna Innere Stadt, then Prague Old Town: walk to markets
getAround: No car. CAT or S-Bahn from VIE airport, U-Bahn and trams. Direct train Vienna Hbf to Prague hl.n. ~4h, about EUR 20 to 30 booked ahead.
entry: Passport valid 3+ months past exit. Schengen, no visa, 90/180 days. EES biometrics live since Apr 10 2026; ETIAS not yet required.
events: Vienna Christkindlmarkt, Rathausplatz: Nov 13 to Dec 26 2026, 10am to 10pm
Schonbrunn Palace Christmas market: Nov 6 2026 to Jan 6 2027
Prague Old Town Square market: late Nov 2026 (opening reported Nov 20 to 30) to Jan 6 2027
Prague Wenceslas Square market: Nov 28 2026 to Jan 6 2027 (Visit Czechia)
